notes.notes: Small bug fix for nav mesh not generating in Ravenshore

notes.title: Feb 26 Update
notes.notes:
Just a small update to fix some issues reported when hitting the evac area in co-op games as well as further expansion of the maps as I build out the adventure mode further

Also, an ENDLESS difficulty has been added for those seeking that class wave-based zombie smashing action

notes.title: Feb 23 Update - NEW Single Player Adventure Mode + FREE Guns
notes.notes:
They Bite has officially turned one whole week old!

To celebrate, im pushing the next update live which includes the following notables

Added new setting to make all weapons free of change in Standard mode
Added all new single player adventure mode

A preview can be seen here

[previewyoutube=NV-uiEpyxXY;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]About the new mode[/b]

The new adventure mode is still very early on but the idea of the mode is to allow players to roam through the maps (you can transition through them via travel points) whilst gaining XP, cash etc and doing missions

In my effort to make this game fully gamepad compatible, the UI has been made from the ground up (check out the map view etc) 

There will be bugs, but nothing I cant solve 

Untill the next update... enjoy smashing Z's in the face!

notes.title: Feb 19 Update
notes.notes:
Level/XP based stat boosts added. Now, as you level up your stats such as carry capacity, health etc are given boosts to help you slay the Zeds.

Equipment area added to Lobby - You can now purchase temporary armor to help protect your avatar in the lobby which will be carried into the next game (once used, you need to buy it again)

notes.title: Feb 18 Update - Ladies night!
notes.notes:
Thanks to user feedback - Fixed female avatar as well as added relevant sounds if in use

Corrected logic on Zed ammo drops, now if killed by a melee weapon, the Zed will drop ammo applicable for whatever gun you might be carrying which DOES take ammo

Adjusted ADS logic to return to ADS state after a reload if input is held

notes.title: Feb 17 Update
notes.notes:
Updated all maps, focussing on building out all areas of Ravenshore (the police station being top of my list) adding lighting, blockades and so on.

Added more ammo stations and temp weapon pickups to all maps

Adjusted weapon stats for better variety
